test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The GV Raja Memorial Trophy, Sir Ashutosh Mukherjee Trophy and Santosh Trophy are related to which of the following sports in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Football**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The GV Raja Memorial Trophy is an annual football tournament held in Kerala, India, named after the sports promoter, Col. Godavarma Raja.
 
• The Sir Ashutosh Mukherjee Trophy is associated with football tournaments at the university level in India, aimed at promoting the sport among students.
 
• The Santosh Trophy is one of the most prestigious football tournaments in India, organized by the All India Football Federation (AIFF), and serves as the national championship for state teams.
 
• These tournaments have played a significant role in the development and promotion of football at various levels, from grassroots to professional, within the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **All India Football Federation (AIFF)**

 
 
• The AIFF is the governing body of football in India and is responsible for organizing national tournaments such as the Santosh Trophy, I-League, and Indian Super League (ISL).
 
• It was founded in 1937 and is affiliated with the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) and the Asian Football Confederation (AFC).
 
 
 
• **Indian Super League (ISL)**
 
 
• The ISL is one of the top professional football leagues in India, established in 2013 to promote football and increase its popularity.
 
• The league operates with a franchise-based model, similar to the Indian Premier League (IPL) in cricket.
 
 
 
• **I-League**
 
 
• The I-League is another prominent professional football league in India, running parallel to the ISL.
 
• It was established in 2007 as the top-tier football league in the country, aimed at improving the standard of Indian football.
 
 
 
• **National Football Team**
 
 
• India's national football team is managed by the AIFF and competes in various international tournaments, including the AFC Asian Cup and FIFA World Cup qualifiers.
 
• Sunil Chhetri, one of India's most famous footballers, has been a key player for the national team, contributing significantly to its success.
